title: EPISODE 1: THE LAST SUPERMARKET
fullScript: Rule 14: Never grab canned food from the bottom shelf during an outbreak. At 48 hours post-infection, condensation degrades bottom tin seals by 80%. Anaerobic spores incubate inside, turning contents into lethal neurotoxin. I needed calories, but adrenaline made my trembling elbow clip a display rack. Eighty decibels echoed through the aisles. Distance to exit: 14 meters. Three blind sprinters breached aisle four, hunting the metallic sound. I hurled a red flare into aisle two and sprinted for the heavy fire door. Safe. But looking at the steel latch... the blood on the inside handle wasn't mine.
